profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer who enjoys the challenges you find on a daily basis on the Software Industry, most of experience has been around end to end web development which means design heavy used backend APIs and all the way up to the front end without missing the aspects like security, testability, maintainability.

Currently I'm a part of the Seller Experience Team at Amazon where I drive the backend API for the whole customer/seller platform. Part of my job is redesign, creating, maintaining and improve a heavily used service .

My professional experience is mainly based on Java Full Stack Software Development (JEE) and the common Open source tools used for enterprise applications like Spring, Hibernate, Maven, etc. 

I have also had my fair share of experience on other roles as: Business Analysis, Technical Support, Quality Assurance, Professional training for IT certificates and Project Management.

During my career I have been a team member that you can rely to get the things done, to do the right thing, to get the results in time and fashion. These attributes have helped me to be a leader in the companies that I have worked on no matter the size of them.

My dream job involves designing, coding, being a facilitator for the team, a mentor for younger fellas, a voice that gives you that pursuits untiringly the best for the customer. 

I speak Spanish (native) and English is my second Language. 

Specialties: JavaEE Stack, MySql, Oracle DB, Spring, Struts 2, Hibernate, Continuous Integration, Test Driven Development, HTML, CSS, JSP & Servlets, JS libraries, Agile Methodologies, Scrum, Quality Assurance, Junit, Oracle Retail Point-of-Service, Apache JMeter, Functional and Non Functional Testing.

I'm an Open Networker, so if you are a Software Engineer, want to become one or just share some of the interests I've listed around here, hit me up! I enjoy discussion and meeting people as much as I enjoy doing software.

positions.title: SDE III
positions.description:
•	Developed the features of the Amazon QLDB drivers for java, python, nodejs and C#
•	Setup the cloud infrastructure using Amazon ECS to run load tests for Amazon QLDB evaluated the performance of the new regions built. 
•	Created a full serverless sample application that demonstrated how to use Amazon QLDB transactions in multi layered application
•	Team lead that constantly improved the public documentation of QLDB, answer questions in AWS Forums and Defined the roadmap for the Developer Experience for Amazon QLD.
Technology stack Java, Python, QLDB, CloudWatch, ECS, .Net, Git, Lambda, CloudFormation, Docker.

positions.title: SDE III - AWS Secret Project
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented the authentication system that would work to onboard Enterprise Identity Services and also personal accounts. Design was horizontally scalable to millions of users and followed best practices about security.
•	Designed and implemented the architecture of a platform to integrate with 3rd party apis to bring "Alexa-like" skills to integrate pull and push data. The architecture involved a set of microservices to handle the user tokens/secrets, an event coordinator service, a control plane to register the skill to the user and a data plane to execute the skill. Also defined the manifest for the skills to integrate the third party services.
Technology stack Java, Graphana, EC2, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, Clean Architecture, Cucumber, React, Typescript, Mocha, Lambda

positions.title: SDE III
positions.description: •	Led the migration of the CMS to Oracle and later to DynamoDb with minimal downtime of 2 minutes and without loss of data.

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
•	Redesign the Amazon's company-wide CMS backend using DDD to make it multitenant and horizontally scalable to handle a 5k TPS with a 20% increase of customer cases YoY with an availability of 99.9%.
•	Designed a multitenant event processing service to route cases and send notifications to tenant's systems. The system routed 20M cases per year.
•	Led multiple code quality and operations initiatives to improve the code quality and have safer deployments to move to a CI/CD model. Improvements led to reduce deployment time WW from 1 week to 2 days. And a Code base with a code coverage of 80%.
•	Mentored 10 new members of the organization, gave tech talks and brown bags about Software Craftsmanship, Code Quality, Spring framework internals.
Technology stack Java, DynamoDb, SNS, SQS, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven-Design, BDD, Hibernate.

projects.title: STOFactura PAC
projects.description: Se participo en el proyecto de manera directa en la administracion de los servicios y servidores de alojamiento de la solución así como de las pruebas funcionales y certificación ante el SAT
